name: Dracomancer (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
Dragons represent the ultimate in arcane power. The dracomancer doesn’t just learn about dragons, but also channels their power directly into their body.

Base Attack Bonus: The dracomancer has a base attack bonus equal to that of that of a magus of equal level.

Hit Dice: The dracomancer uses a d8 to determine their hit points.

Saving Throws: The dracomancer has good fortitude and will saving throws.

Class Skills: The dracomancer adds Climb (Str) and Swim (Str) to their class skill list. This modifies skills.

Spellcasting: The dracomancer has less spellcasting power compared to the more typical legendary arcanist, receiving only 6 levels of spells over their career. Spells above 6th level are still considered on their spell list for the purpose of using spell completion items.

Draconic Reservoir: All the dracomancer’s class abilities, including their arcane reservoir and all of their exploits, use Strength in place of Charisma.

Draconic Spells: The dracomancer adds the following spells to their spell list:

0th—resistance
1st—acid maw, cause fear
2nd—fire breath, pouncing fury, savage maw, scale spikes, shadow claws
3rd—draconic malice, draconic reservoir, prehensile pilfer, scale spikes, greater, scales of deflection, tail strike
4th—bloody claws, dragon’s breath, fear, strong jaw
5th—dominate person, overland flight, polymorph, teleport
6th—form of the alien dragon I, form of the dragon I, form of the exotic dragon I
7th—form of the alien dragon II, form of the dragon II, form of the exotic dragon II
8th—form of the alien dragon III, form of the dragon III, form of the exotic dragon III
9th—dominate monster, overwhelming presence

Draconic Energy (Su)

At 1st level, the dracomancer chooses an energy type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. They gain resistance to this energy type equal to their class level + 10 and become immune at 20th level. Each of the energy types is connected to an element: earth (acid), water (cold), air (electricity) or flame (fire). The dracomancer must choose this element as one of their affinities at 1st level.

This modifies affinities.

Draconic Weapons (Su)

The dracomancer has the ability to transform parts of their body into more draconic equivalents. All transformations are free actions and can be used an unlimited number of times.

Claws of the Dragon: At 1st level, the dracomancer can transform their hands into powerful claws. These are primary natural weapons that do 1d4 damage (1d3 if the dracomancer is small, 1d6 if large), but which can still wear rings and use tools normally. They also grant the dracomancer a +4 competence bonus to climb any surface they can damage (it has a hardness of 5 or less), but not something like a rope.
Teeth of the Dragon: At 3rd level, the dracomancer can transform their mouth into a dragon’s mouth. This is a secondary natural weapon that does 1d6 damage (1d4 if the dracomancer is small, 1d8 if large).
Horns of the Dragon: At 6th level, the dracomancer can grow horns. This is a secondary natural attack that does 1d4 damage (1d3 if the dracomancer is small, 1d6 if large), but does triple damage on a charge.
Tail of the Dragon: At 9th level, the dracomancer can grow a tail. This is a secondary natural attack that deals 1d4 damage (1d3 if the dracomancer is small, 1d6 if large), and has an additional 5 feet of natural reach. While the dracomancer has a tail, they gain a +4 bonus to all CMD checks to avoid being knocked prone.
Speed of the Dragon: At 12th level, the dracomancer gains the pounce ability.
Wings of the Dragon: At 15th level, the dracomancer can sprout wings from their back. In addition to giving them a 60 feet speed, it grants them two wing buffet secondary natural attacks that do 1d4 damage each (1d3 if the dracomancer is small, 1d6 if large).
Eyes of the Dragon: At 18th level, the dracomancer’s eyes can turn into draconic eyes, granting them blindsight 30 feet. This replaces arcane surge.
Arcane Enhancement (Su)

As a swift action, the dracomancer can spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir to enhance all their natural weapons for 1 minute. While active, this enhancement grants a +1 untyped bonus to attack and damage rolls, with an additional +1 every 4 levels after to a maximum of +5 at 17th level.

While the enhancement is active, the dracomancer’s natural weapons become magical weapons, and ignore DR/magic. At 3rd level, their natural weapons ignore DR/cold iron and DR/silver. At 7th level, their natural weapons are treated as though they had the ghost touch enhancement. At 11th level, the dracomancer may choose an alignment (chaos, evil, good, or law) when activating this ability; their natural weapons have that alignment for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. The alignment need not match their own. At 15th level, the dracomancer’s natural weapons ignore DR/adamantine, and at 19th level, they ignore DR/—.

This replaces the arcane exploit gained at first level.

Breath of the Dragon (Su)

At 5th level, as a standard action, the dracomancer may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir to exhale a blast of their energy type in either a 15’ cone or a 30 feet line. This blast does 1d6 damage per class level of their energy type, with those within being granted a Reflex saving throw with a DC of 10 + half the dracomancer’s class level + their Strength modifier to halve the damage. If the saving throw is failed, the target also receives an additional penalty based on the energy type of the weapon:

Acid breath weapons cause creatures to be sickened for 1 round
Cold breath weapons cause creatures to be staggered for 1 round
Electricity breath weapons cause creatures to be flatfooted for 1 round
Fire breath weapons cause creatures to be blinded for 1 round

At 11th level, the dracomancer’s breath weapon doubles its range (a 30 feet cone or 60 feet line).

At 17th level, the damage from the dracomaner’s breath weapon increases to 1d8 per class level.

Fighter Training (Ex)

At 8th level, the dracomancer counts half their class level as their fighter level for the purpose of qualifying for feats. If they have levels in fighter, these levels stack.

True Form (Sp)

At 10th level, the dracomancer may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir to cast form of the dragon I on themselves.

At 12th level, they may choose to cast form of the dragon II, or they may cast form of the dragon I with the duration extended to 10 minutes per level.

At 14th level, they may choose to cast form of the dragon III, or they may cast form of the dragon II with the duration extended to 10 minutes per level, or they may cast form of the dragon I with the duration extended to 1 hour per level.

At 16th level, they may choose to cast form of the dragon III with the duration extended to 10 minutes per level, or they may cast form of the dragon II with the duration extended to 1 hour per level.

At 18th level, they may choose to cast form of the dragon III with the duration extended to 1 hour per level.

Arcanist Exploits

A dracomancer can select the following exploit.

Scales of the Dragon

The dracomancer can harden their skin into scales, granting them natural armor equal to their Strength modifier, but no higher than their class level.

Greater Exploits

A dracomancer can choose from the following additional greater exploits.

Natural Critical (Ex)

The dracomancer gains the benefit of the Critical Strike feat with all natural weapons.

Stalwart (Ex)

If the dracomancer makes a Fortitude or Will saving throw against an attack that has a reduced effect on a successful save, they instead avoid the effect entirely.
